note.name: Robinhood Tokenized NVIDIA Stock
note.horizonLabel: into the 17 Nov earnings / over the next 8 weeks
note.thesis: A tokenised NVDA claim sits at its 30-day low while the underlying stock faces a dated board crisis. The balance of evidence tilts lower, but not strongly enough for a directional view: the token has no independent price driver and could follow NVDA either way.
note.what: NVDA is Robinhood's tokenised NVIDIA stock on CoinGecko id nvidia-robinhood-tokenized-stock. It is not equity. Issuer documents describe a debt note that pays the NVDA price, so holders get 24/7 price exposure and dividend reinvestment through a multiplier, without shareholder rights, and redeem only for cash through an approved dealer.

points.text: The token closed at $161, down 18.3% over seven days and 27.7% over 30 days, at the bottom of its 30- and 90-day ranges.
The board met to decide whether to oust Jensen Huang and NVDA fell more than 9% after hours; a second affair was reported the next day.
Reuters reports the affair allegedly aided $7.5B in chip shipments to China, and analysts flag class-action and board-liability exposure.
The token simply tracks NVDA, so a board decision to retain Huang or a 17 November earnings beat would lift it with the stock.

note.supplyHeadline: No unlocks; units mint against shares
note.supplyText: Nothing is scheduled to unlock over the next 90 days: units are minted to buyers and burned on redemption, so supply follows flows, not a vesting calendar. Pegproof read 116,775.8 shares outstanding, up 24.7% in a week, with a multiplier of 1.000775; CoinGecko's circulating figure is 116,679.
note.valuationHeadline: No fees or revenue to price
note.valuationText: The token charges no disclosed fee and pays no yield, so a $18.79M FDV cannot be set against either measure and the valuation chart stays empty. Fees would be the right yardstick if any were charged. Named peers NVDAB, Coinbase's NVDAc and ST0x wtNVDA publish no FDV, so no comparison is possible.
note.usageText: On-chain activity is mint and burn against shares: pegproof counted 507 issuance and 3,297 redemption transfers in seven days, with net shares up 24,238.56 over that window and 11,778.77 in 24 hours. No incentives, emissions or points farming were found, and no fee revenue is disclosed.

catalysts.text: NVDA earnings expected; the token has no independent driver of its own.

risks.title: Huang retained
risks.text: A board decision to keep the chief executive removes the key-person overhang and would likely lift NVDA and the token.

risks.title: Earnings beat
risks.text: A clean 17 November print would lift the tracked stock, and the token with it.

risks.title: Issuer disclosure improves
risks.text: A live backing attestation or a published fee schedule would undercut the weak legal-claim argument.

risks.title: Faster downside
risks.text: An ouster combined with adverse probe or class-action findings could push the token below the modelled range.

watchlist.item: A debt note, not equity: Issuer documents describe a debt note from an unregulated Jersey company paying the NVDA price; holders own no shares and issuer keys can burn, block or pause it.

note.positioningText: Open interest across exchanges is $357M, up 419.1% over seven days, and the long/short account ratio is 7.53, with 88% of accounts long. Funding was not reported in the data read.
note.conclusion: Robinhood's NVDA note offers round-the-clock exposure but no shareholder rights, no yield and no published backing proof, and it sits at $161 after an 18.3% week. Supply grew while price fell and positioning is long-heavy, yet the direction rests on an unresolved board crisis and the 17 November print.
note.invalidation: Shares outstanding fall for two straight weeks
note.gaps: No fee or revenue data for the token, so no valuation multiple exists. No live backing attestation or holder distribution. No FDV or revenue for NVDAB, Coinbase NVDAc, ST0x wtNVDA or NVDAx, so no peer comparison can be made.
